selection.score: validation mean net log factor; deterministic lexical tie break
selection.fallback: best validation mean among count-qualified models even if negative; label not eligible

bootstrap_unit: calendar month, including months with zero trades
entry: next hourly open, after a closed signal candle
barrier_tie: invalidation first when both barriers touched in one hourly candle
gap_execution: stop gap at next observed open; favorable target gap credited only at target
data_gaps: No imputation. Features require a complete lookback. Plans encountering missing/zero-volume candles before exit are indeterminate and excluded from return means, explicitly counted; no promotion with any indeterminate holdout plan.
fold_boundary: discard signals whose maximum configured 72h outcome extends beyond the fold, regardless of earlier apparent exit

units.SELL_BUY: BTC quantity ratio vs holding identical BTC
units.BUY_SELL: quote currency ratio vs staying in cash; buy-and-hold comparison reported separately

disclosure: Parameter grid frozen before return analysis. Fixed entry at next hourly open and constant costs are execution assumptions, not claims of attainable fills. Future data completeness checks are research-only exclusions, not live signals. One retrospective holdout is not prospective validation. Calendar-month bootstrap with one test year has limited power. This experiment evaluates selection hypotheses, not a finished trading recommendation.
revision_reason: E1 preserved: no model reached predeclared development count. E2 expands event threshold only; thresholds frozen before E2 outcomes; 2025 has not been evaluated. E1 trials remain in the research ledger.
